changelog: v3.2.1: Native Windows System Tray ('BG Taskbar') integration — Closing the app window minimizes to the system tray rather than killing the process, keeping background cadence tracking and AI weak-key adaptation active; Windows startup launches silently into the notification area; Single-instance handshake restores running app on shortcut launch; Context menu with dashboard quick launch, live background keystroke stats, and Windows autostart toggle.
